models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for unauthenticated visitor access.

Guest accounts provide limited access to the application before registration. Each guest is identified by a unique device fingerprint, allowing the system to maintain session state and track temporary activities. Guests can transition to member accounts through the registration process.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_guest_sessions} - Session tokens for guest authentication (child table)

Key characteristics:
- Device-based identification without email/password credentials
- Temporary account state pending registration or abandonment
- Supports guest-to-member transition pathway

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device fingerprint identifier for guest recognition and session tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access with short expiration.

Tracks authentication sessions for guest (unauthenticated) users identified by device fingerprint. Each session stores connection metadata including IP address, current page URL, and referrer for security auditing. Sessions have explicit expiration timestamps and are managed through the authentication flow rather than direct CRUD operations.

References {@link todo_app_guests} as the parent actor table. Multiple sessions can exist per guest (e.g., multiple devices or browsers).

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL when session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the user arrived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions are invalid after this time.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email/password authentication and profile information.

This is the primary actor table for authenticated users in the todo application. Members can create and manage their private todos, view edit history, and use trash functionality. Each member has a unique email address for authentication and a display name for profile identification.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_member_sessions}: Stores JWT session tokens for member authentication
- {@link todo_app_member_password_resets}: Password reset tokens for recovery workflow
- {@link todo_app_member_email_verifications}: Email verification tokens for registration
- {@link todo_app_todos}: Todos owned by this member (1:N relationship)

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown in their profile and todo ownership.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted. Null means account is active.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

Stores active login sessions for registered members, tracking connection metadata and expiration times. Each session represents an authenticated connection that can be validated using JWT tokens. Sessions are created upon successful login and invalidated upon logout or expiration.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through a one-to-many relationship where one member can have multiple concurrent sessions across different devices or browsers.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security enforcement.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for member password recovery workflow.

Stores temporary reset tokens generated when members request password resets. Each token has a limited lifespan and can only be used once. After successful password reset or expiration, the token becomes invalid.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through member ownership relationship. Multiple reset tokens can exist per member, but only the most recent unexpired token should be used.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account requesting password reset. {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed value of the password reset token for secure lookup. Never store plain text tokens.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires. Token cannot be used after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was consumed. Null if token has not been used.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for member registration and email confirmation workflow.

Stores verification tokens sent to members during registration or email change processes. Each token has an expiration time and tracks when (if) the email was successfully verified. Multiple verification attempts can exist per member, with the most recent valid token being used for verification.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through foreign key relationship.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token sent via email for email confirmation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which verification is invalid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email was successfully verified, null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the verification record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the verification record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: User todo items representing tasks to be completed. Each todo belongs to a single member and contains title, optional description, optional start and due dates, and completion status. Supports soft delete for trash functionality where deleted todos can be restored or permanently removed. All todos are private to their owner with no cross-user access.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title. Required field that identifies the task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task. Can be empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date indicating when the todo task begins. Null means no specific start date.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date indicating when the todo task should be completed. Null means no specific deadline.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status flag. False by default for new todos, toggled to true when marked complete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Used for sorting and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last modified. Updated on every edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null for active todos, set to deletion timestamp when moved to trash. Used to filter between active and deleted todos.

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description: Edit history entries that automatically record field-level changes to todos. Each entry captures what values were changed to (not the old values) with timestamps for audit trail purposes. History entries are immutable, automatically generated on todo edits, and cascade deleted when the parent todo is permanently deleted. This is a snapshot table for audit trail and change tracking.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New title value after the edit. Only populated if the title field was changed.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New description value after the edit. Only populated if the description field was changed.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date value after the edit. Only populated if the start date field was changed.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date value after the edit. Only populated if the due date field was changed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history entry was created, representing when the edit occurred. Automatically set on record creation and serves as the edit timestamp for chronological ordering.
